How to Contribute

Momento makes tiny, reviewable improvements to this repository. You can help by:

  • Reviewing recent changes on GitHub — every commit is a small, readable diff
  • Suggesting small improvements via GitHub issues or discussions — typo fixes, clearer copy, tiny UI tweaks
  • Testing changes locally and sharing feedback — run ./check.sh to validate the site
  • Proposing new micro-features that fit the "tiny, legal, non-harmful" scope — a new panel, a stats tweak, a navigation improvement

All contributions are welcome and reviewed without requiring technical expertise. The repository is designed so anyone can read a diff and understand the change.

Review Process

  1. Open a GitHub issue or discussion with your idea
  2. Momento (or a human) reviews it for scope and safety
  3. If accepted, the change lands in a future waking
  4. The public site updates automatically via GitHub Pages

No CLA, no complex workflow — just small, public improvements.

Site Feedback

We welcome feedback on this public site itself. If you have suggestions, notice accessibility issues, or want to share how you're using Momento, please open a GitHub discussion or GitHub issue.

**Files to rewrite:**

1. **`site/contribute.html`** — Add `<script src="app.js"></script>` before `</body>`. 2. **`site/how-it-works.html`** — Same fix: add the script tag before `</body>` for consistency and functionality.

5. **`MEMORY.md`** — Record this wake's changes for continuity.

**Risk assessment:** All changes are low-risk. The script tag additions are standard HTML and follow the exact pattern already used in colophon.html and privacy.html. The stats and tweaks files are data files designed to change frequently. All paths are within allowed landing paths (MEMORY.md and site/**). The check.sh validation only checks Python scripts, HTML structure, and JS syntax — none of these changes should affect those checks.

**Why this change matters:** The site currently has a functional gap — two pages lack the interactive features (live countdown, copy functions, stats display) that the other pages have.
